'''Hateable''' [[vermin]] (creatures with the {{token|VERMIN_HATEABLE|c}} [[Creature_token|token]]) can appear as negative dwarven [[preference]]s. Dwarves who encounter detested vermin may experience a negative [[thought]]. Being hated by some dwarves does not prevent the vermin from appearing as a positive preference for other dwarves. Be careful when setting up your [[zoo]]s - poor creature selections engravings can lead to [[tantrum spiral|civil unrest]].
